cases.name: strict-equality-matches-the-number-written-beside-it
cases.description: The defect === was fixed for. A column is text and a literal is a number, so the host language's identity test answered "different types" — and `N === 1` was false for every number on every row, silently, with check passing.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="0,1,2,3" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}:</data><data if="N === 0"> is0</data><data if="N === 1"> is1</data><data if="N !== 1"> not1</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: strict-equality-is-text-so-the-printed-shape-decides
cases.description: Four columns that all READ as the number one and print differently. `== 1` is true for every one of them; `=== 1` only for the one that prints "1".
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="1,01,1.0,+1" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>"${{N}}"</data><data if="N == 1"> ==1</data><data if="N === 1"> ===1</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: loose-equality-reads-a-decimal-column-as-a-number
cases.description: A money column holding "100.00" used to fail `== 100` while passing `> 99` — the ordering operators read it as a hundred and only equality disagreed, and said nothing. Both now agree.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Total"><gen type="text" value="100.00,0.00,99.50" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Total}}:</data><data if="Total == 100"> eq100</data><data if="Total > 99"> over99</data><data if="Total == 0"> eq0</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-two-texts-that-count-as-false
cases.description: Only the empty text and "false" are false; every other text is true, "0" included. Lua's and Ruby's rule, carried into a language whose only carrier is text.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="x,0,00,0.0,false,true" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Blank"><gen type="text" value="x" missing="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>"${{V}}":</data><data if="V"> true</data><data if="!V"> false</data><data> blank:</data><data if="Blank">true</data><data if="!Blank">false</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-flag-column-holds-the-word-not-the-boolean
cases.description: _last and every anomaly_flag column hold the TEXT "true" or "false". `==` compares numbers and neither is one, so it answers false; `===` compares what both print, and both print "true".
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Flag"><gen type="text" value="true,false,true" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Flag}}:</data><data if="Flag"> bare</data><data if="Flag == true"> ==true</data><data if="Flag === true"> ===true</data><data if="Flag === 'true'"> ==='true'</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: strict-equality-between-two-columns-is-plain-text-equality
cases.description: No coercion in either direction: `"01" === "1"` is false where `"01" == "1"` is true, because the first asks about the characters and the second about the number.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="01,1,x,0" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="text" value="1,1,x,00" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}/${{B}}:</data><data if="A == B"> ==</data><data if="A === B"> ===</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-built-in-last-row-flag-reads-as-a-bare-name
cases.description: `if="!_last"` is the comma-between-items idiom, and it works only because the text "false" is falsy — _last interpolates as a word, not a boolean.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data><data if="!_last">,</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: in-is-the-operator-for-lists
cases.description: A list is only ever the right side of `in` — TDC259 refuses one anywhere else, so `===` never meets a list in a config that validates. Comparison inside `in` is as loose as `==`.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="1,01,x" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}:</data><data if="N in [1, 2]"> in</data><data if="N in [x, y]"> word</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-exact-whole-number-stays-exact-under-both-equalities
cases.description: One past 2^53, where a double stops knowing which integer it is. `==` compares the two as whole numbers and `===` compares the digits, so neither can round the answer away.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="text" value="9007199254740993,9007199254740992" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}:</data><data if="N == 9007199254740993"> ==</data><data if="N === 9007199254740993"> ===</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: reading-text-as-a-number-is-generous-and-strict-is-not
cases.description: An empty column reads as zero and "0x10" reads as sixteen — the rule working as specified, and the reason to reach for === whenever the characters are the question.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value=" ,0x10,7" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>"${{V}}":</data><data if="V == 0"> ==0</data><data if="V == 16"> ==16</data><data if="V === 16"> ===16</data><data if="V == 7"> ==7</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-written-number-is-false-only-at-zero
cases.description: The other half of truthiness. A column is text and "0" is true, but a number the config WROTE is false at zero, like the double beside it. Two of the five used to answer true here; nothing in the fixtures said which was right.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="cmp" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Zero"><gen type="text" value="0"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>flags:</data><data if="0"> lit0</data><data if="1 - 1"> sub0</data><data if="1"> lit1</data><data if="Zero"> col0</data></line></block></tdc>
